audience: online store owners who sell with Foxy.io

useCases.title: Review the latest orders and what was bought
useCases.text: The AI lists a store's transactions, newest first, and opens one with its items, customer and payments. You see what sold and who bought it.

useCases.title: Find customers with active subscriptions
useCases.text: The AI lists subscriptions and customers, and opens one subscription with its related data. You see who pays on repeat and when the next run is.

useCases.title: Look at carts that were not finished
useCases.text: The AI lists the in-progress and abandoned carts of a store. You get a view of checkouts that did not complete.

useCases.title: Check the discount codes and their rules
useCases.text: The AI lists the coupons of a store with their rules, so you can see which codes exist.

useCases.title: Pause, move or fix a subscription or customer
useCases.text: The AI changes a subscription's next transaction date, frequency or active state, or a customer's first name, last name or email. This changes live store data.
